asset.name: Chainlink

score_rationales.supply: LINK is structurally positive on tokenomics because supply is capped at 1,000,000,000 with no inflationary mining, and 727,099,970 already circulates (72.7%), reducing long-run dilution risk versus uncapped assets. The main offset is the remaining 272.9M non-circulating tokens, which still represents meaningful future distribution/sell-pressure overhang, and holder concentration remains relatively high in large wallets (including treasury/contract-controlled balances), which weakens decentralization of supply. Staking helps but is still moderate in scale (Chainlink Staking v0.2 capacity is ~45M LINK, about 4.5% of max supply), so lock-up driven sell-pressure reduction is supportive but not yet strong enough to push supply dynamics into top-tier bullish territory.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Broad oracle integrations and enterprise TVS.
score_rationales.value_capture: Daily revenue: $1.1M (~$417.2M/year). No TVL (oracle/infra model, scored on absolute revenue). Daily fees: $1.2M.
